source: RimWorld wiki (Filth); the chances are ours
note: A pawn walking on bare ground (no floor) picks dirt up on its shoes with pickupChancePerCell for each new cell, times its def's stats.filthRate; it drops what it carries on floors with dropChancePerCell for each new cell. Trackable filth in the cell it enters is picked up the same way. A bleeding pawn drops about bloodPerBleedDay blood an hour for each point of blood loss a day it bleeds. ticksToSeconds is 1.44: a RimWorld tick is 1/60 s and our game day is 86,400 s against RimWorld's 60,000 ticks.

Beauty: total of the room's cells and the ring of cells around it, over the room size (a room under 40 cells counts as 20 + size/2). Space: 1.4 a cell, minus 0.9 for each cell holding something you cannot stand on. Impressiveness as the wiki's formula. Wealth: market value of buildings in and around the room plus floors in it; a building's market value is its materials plus 0.0036 per RimWorld tick of work (ours: workToBuild is in game seconds, 1.44 per tick). The impressiveness soft cap for space is flagged [Verify] on the wiki.

The need is 0 to 1; 35% to 65% is neutral. A pawn judges the average beauty of the cells within sightRadius metres it can see (about 241 cells). The need heads for a level that is a straight line of that average: 35% at beautyAtNeutralMin, 65% at beautyAtNeutralMax (the wiki's 'ugly' and 'pretty' edges), moving up quickly and down slowly, and only while the pawn is awake. Mood stages are the Beauty thought.
